description: NaMgCr₂In(H₂O₅)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.98 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra and corners with three CrO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 62-63°. There are two shorter (1.98 Å) and two longer (1.99 Å) Mg-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Cr sites. In the first Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-45°. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.79 Å. In the second Cr site, Cr is bonded to four O atoms to form CrO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent InO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-51°. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.65-1.81 Å. In is bonded to six O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four CrO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of In-O bond distances ranging from 2.14-2.26 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one In and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Mg, one In, and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Mg and one Cr atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one Cr atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na and one Cr atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one In atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one In atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Mg, one Cr, and one In atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one In atom.
